subject: dxf/importinto: add import-into history job info API (#66813)
summary: Adds a SYSTEM-KS-only status API `/dxf/import-into/history/job/{keyspace}/{job_id}` that reads IMPORT INTO task/subtask history from `mysql.tidb_global_task_history` and `mysql.tidb_background_subtask_history` to return job metrics (sizes, speeds, durations), and factors import-into task-key formatting into a dedicated `taskkey` package with unit/handler tests.
